scope: Additive Frosty L1-15 and permanent Frostmite spawned-subunit evidence audit. Temporary Frostmite Spell content is excluded.
game_version: Official Frosty introduction 2022-10-10 and L11-15 availability 2025-06-16; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba; current 18.600.3 child values and slow/spawn timing unverified.

sources.title: Full Release Notes
sources.levels: Frosty initial levels; no numerical Frostmite level table
facts: Frosty favors targets within 4.5 tiles of its Hero, attacks ground and air, slows defenses, and occasionally releases Frostmites that attack enemy defenses and slow them.
sources.limitations: The article does not define spawn cadence or position, Frostmite HP/damage/speed, projectile and impact timing, slow magnitude/duration, stacking or simultaneous-event order.

sources.title: Welcome to Let’s Get Crafty Update!
facts: Frosty L11-15 were released at TH17.
sources.limitations: No per-level hitpoints, DPS, summon count, cap or Frostmite child values are given.

sources.title: Pinned Frosty Home Village Pet record
facts: The Frosty parent record has per-level frostmitesPerSummon and maxFrostmites, plus a top-level eight-second summonCooldown.
sources.limitations: It gives no Frostmite entity record or current client build, and does not define the first spawn phase, count under cap pressure or exact slow contract.

sources.publisher: Clash of Clans Wiki on Fandom
sources.title: Frosty/Frostmite
facts: Search-index excerpt describes a short-lived Frostmite attack against defenses.
sources.limitations: Direct retrieval was blocked. The excerpt gives no build-pinned child HP, damage, movement, lifespan or slow timing; it is a research lead only.

derivations.result: Retain raw frostmitesPerSummon and maxFrostmites as catalogue per-level fields
derivations.method: Lossless normalization of the pinned Frosty parent record; these are data only and do not schedule a spawn.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use the Frostmite Spell's temporary-event values for Frosty's permanent child
rejected_inferences.reason: The spell is explicitly excluded from scope and no source establishes equal child stats or mechanics.

rejected_inferences.rule: Spawn Frostmites exactly every eight seconds from deployment
rejected_inferences.reason: The raw cooldown omits initial phase, spawn position, cap behavior and simultaneous tick order.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use a generic Ice Pup or Firemite actor and slow effect
rejected_inferences.reason: No source supports Frostmite-specific HP, movement, attack, slow magnitude, duration or stacking.

items: attack target transitions and projectile timing
spawn first phase, cap and tick ordering
current child HP, damage, speed, hitbox and lifetime
spawn position and deterministic entity ordering

conclusion: Frosty L1-15 and its required permanent Frostmites remain partial and catalogue-only. Parent summon counts and caps are retained with provenance, but missing child stats and deterministic spawn/slow rules prevent a faithful Core actor.
